goals.title: Reach the Deep Caverns
goals.description: Build early Mining levels and unlock the underground ore areas.
steps: Reach Mining V.
Travel from the Gold Mine to the Deep Caverns.

goals.title: Enter the Dwarven Mines
goals.description: Unlock commissions, Mithril, Titanium, the Forge and Heart of the Mountain.
steps: Reach Mining XII.
Speak to Rhys in the Obsidian Sanctuary and inspect the current material trade.
Enter the Dwarven Mines.

goals.title: Enter the Crystal Hollows
goals.description: A gemstone, nucleus and powder progression branch.
steps: Reach HotM III.
Speak to Gwendolyn and obtain an entry pass.

goals.title: Enter the Glacite Tunnels
goals.description: Late mining progression with Glacite Powder, Mineshafts and fossils.
steps: Reach HotM VII.
Complete the current Dwarven base-camp entry quest.
Prepare Cold resistance and a suitable drill.
